abstract: In early adolescence, I experienced recurrent troubling episodes of derealization and dissociation. Experiences of synchronicity—moments of deep confirmation—occurred later. I never connected these disparate states until now./// In junior high, when I had little sleep, I sometimes entered school sensing that I and everyone around me were moving in choreographed rhythm.
